title: Before you start
intro: FeralSpotter collects the following when you add photos and record a sighting:

items.label: Photos
items.text: that you take in the app or select from your library. Only photos you add are uploaded; uploads can begin before you submit the sighting.

items.label: Location and time
items.text: from the device when you take a photo, from available metadata on selected library photos, or from corrections you enter.

items.label: Cat details
items.text: and annotations you enter, sent when you submit the sighting.

items.label: Your account
items.text: including your account identifier and email address, to associate your data with your account.

body: Photos and sighting details are uploaded to private project cloud storage. Choosing an organization in the sighting form records your sharing permissions; it does not currently deliver the sighting to that organization.
By continuing, you agree to this collection and upload, including photo uploads while a sighting is unfinished. Email updates and usage analytics are optional and have separate choices.
declineWarningBody: Without permissions, you won't be able to use FeralSpotter.
locationOnceWarningBody: If you chose "Only this time" for location, Android revokes that access as soon as the app closes. Location may not be captured next time you open FeralSpotter until you grant access again.

analytics.title: One more thing
analytics.intro: Optional usage analytics helps us understand app behavior and investigate errors.
analytics.label: Usage analytics
analytics.text: app events and error information linked to your account identifier, to help us improve FeralSpotter

emailOptIn.title: Stay in the loop?
emailOptIn.intro: We can send you news about FeralSpotter by email. This is optional.
emailOptIn.label: Email updates
emailOptIn.text: about FeralSpotter news and project updates, sent to the email address on your account. You can turn this off at any time in Settings.
